name: Christian Tithing
overview: Christian tithing is presented in Scripture as a sacred act of giving a tenth of one's produce or income back to the Lord, recognizing His ownership and holiness over all things, as stated in Leviticus 27:30. Malachi 3:10 emphasizes the importance of bringing tithes into God's storehouse to support His work, promising abundant blessings in return for faithful giving. Luke 6:38 further teaches that generosity will be rewarded manifold, affirming that the measure we give will be the measure we receive, encouraging believers to give with a joyful and trusting heart.
